name: QuizArena
shortDescription: Collaborative quiz platform with seeded shuffling, leaderboards and quiz-bank import/export.
features: Quiz creation with prompts, options, explanations, difficulty, tags
Attempts are deterministic from a recorded shuffle seed (reproducible)
Wrong-answer review with explanations after submit
Leaderboard: best score then fastest time (documented tie-break)
Quiz-bank JSON import with per-row validation errors (nothing dropped silently)
knownLimitations: Demo data simulated; realtime collaboration is polling-based here
Duration tracking is optional; not a proctoring tool
